verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own materials explain some premium processing mechanics. The pricing page gives the cost ("Premium Processing fees, around $3K"), and the EB-1A guide states the 15-business-day decision window and that premium processing does not change the evidentiary standard. Coverage is thin and limited to EB-1A, with no Form I-907 explanation across visa types. Missing for 10: a list of which classifications qualify for premium processing beyond EB-1A, an explicit Form I-907 explanation, detail on what premium processing does not speed up (e.g. later stages or consular steps), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider explains premium processing (Form I-907) mechanics — which classifications qualify, what it costs, and what it does and does not speed up

citations.quote: Premium processing delivers a 15-business-day decision on EB-1A petitions, but it does not change the standard applied to your evidence.
